title: Discrete positivity and maximum principles for a finite element discretization of the Richards equation
summary: Standard finite element discretizations of the Richards equation may violate the discrete minimum principle, producing unphysical negative saturations. While existing bound-preserving methods typically rely on computationally expensive fully implicit solvers, we propose a novel semi-implicit finite element framework utilizing a bounded continuous auxiliary variable. Our approach treats the gravity-driven advective term using a linearly implicit technique, which improves the time-step restrictions required by explicit gravity methods near the degenerate limit.
